Name: Joja Blackmarket
Author: CopperSun
Description:
So you finished the community center and realized there are some things you just can't live without. No problem! A shady character in the bus tunnel will be happy to sell you a few goods - at premium prices, of course.

Welcome to the Joja Blackmarket! Manned by fine, upstanding citizens this shop is a purveyor of precious Joja goods, gems, and artifacts. They'll also happily buy any spare swords or monster loot you might have lying around. Where can you find such a marvelous shop? Why, just around the corner from your farm in the conveniently located tunnel! But some of the townspeople have noticed strange things going on and aren't so happy...


[u]Goods sold[/u]
[spoiler]Joja Cola
Joja Light
Auto-petter (if CC complete)
Random gem (cheaper gems are more common)
Random artifact, slime egg, or other nice prize (common artifacts are more common)
Joja Seeds (must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8746]Joja Seeds[/url])
Joja Fruit Tree Crops (must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8770]Asters Fruit Trees as Crops[/url])
Joja MMOs (if CC complete and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] installed)[/spoiler]


[u]Description but boring[/u]
[spoiler]If you go in the bus tunnel there is now a "shop" in which Joja goods can be purchased for scalper prices. These prices increase after CC completion. A random gem (x5) and a random artifact (or rarely a slime egg, pearl, golden pumpkin, or dragon tooth) will be available for purchase each day. You can also sell swords, rings, and monster loot to the shop so you don't have to wait for Marlon to open up or if it's 1 and he's already closed.

In addition, a week after CC completion (or a day after you first load the mod on an existing save) you will receive a letter inviting you to the tunnel and some NPCs will have comments about the shady things they've noticed recently.

This mod may also be used to sell JA Joja goods if SVE is installed and you cannot otherwise edit the Joja shop.[/spoiler]


[u]Compatibility[/u]
Should be compatible with nearly all mods. Does make a change to the tunnel, but I don't know of any other mods that change that spot in it so you should be in the clear.

[u]Can I add an item to the Blackmarket?[/u]
Yes! However, [i]you'll[/i] need to do the coding yourself. Fortunately, it's very easy!

If you just want to add some items for yourself, you can open up the file "shops.json" in this mod's STF folder and edit it directly. You can reference [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki/wiki/Tutorial:_Adding_Items_to_a_Shop]this tutorial[/url] for more information.

If you would like to add some items via a published mod, you are welcome to do so with a caveat: please keep the general theme in mind and also please don't be, like, racist or anything. Be cool.

To do so, you will create your own STF mod. You can use the tutorial linked prior for the basic code, and remember that you do not need to repeat any of the existing items (this would cause the inventory for those items to double), just add the code for your own inventory additions. Make sure to include CopperSun.JojaBlackmarketSTF as a dependency in your manifest.

You are also welcome to change the Blackmarket vendor in your mod as you like.

[u]Configuration[/u]
After the CC is complete the shop vendor will change to a familiar face. You can disable this via the config if you have a mod which keeps that familiar, oh-so-punchable face around after CC completion and don't want to consider why s/he might otherwise have a clone.


[u]Requirements[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] - essential to make the shop display
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url] - essential to make the shop work
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi [/url]- essential to mod Stardew Valley
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8770]Asters Fruit Trees as Crops[/url] - [i]Optional[/i]. Adds extra stock.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8746]Joja Seeds[/url] - [i]Optional[/i]. Adds extra stock.


[u]Credits[/u]
Much love to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]LemurKat[/url], who wrote [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki/wiki/Adding_Map_Patches_Using_Tiled]two tutorials[/url] used to make this mod.
Additional appreciation to Tiakall, Richard, and Angie, who all generously assisted in testing and providing screenshots.
